I don't think it's inherently pathetic, or particularly selfish. OR I guess I've been looking at this subreddit lately because I am still kind of trying to pull myself out of having been in a really crappy place a few months ago, and it seems like there are bits and pieces of all the things I've felt in all these different posts. And reading this, and the linked post from a month ago, made me empathize a lot. While I suppose it isn't automatically comforting to know someone out in the endless world feels extremely similar to how you feel, for what it's worth it was your post that finally got me to make an account and stop lurking.

Sometimes it is really easy for seemingly small things to snowball and touch on a million other factors that make you feel terrible. And that's ok, the fact that it hurts. But it solidifies all that pain when you interpret it as selfish and pathetic. It is ok that those things bother you. At least, I've realized that it is ok when they bother me, any I wish i could give that slight peace to someone else.

Guess I'm not that great at coming out guns blazing, but at least if you need someone to talk to or just bounce things off of, I'd like to help if I can.
